[USER] The user is looking for common types of yoga and recommendations for beginners.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common types of yoga include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hatha Yoga: focuses on the physical postures and breathing techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Vinyasa Yoga: includes continuous and fast-paced movements that synchronize with the breath.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Ashtanga Yoga: follows a set sequence of poses, with each movement synchronized with the breath.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Iyengar Yoga: emphasizes precise alignment and holding poses for longer periods of time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Bikram Yoga: involves a series of 26 postures, performed in a heated room.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Kundalini Yoga: aims to awaken energy in the spine, combining physical postures, breathing techniques, and meditation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For beginners, Hatha Yoga and Iyengar Yoga are great options as they focus on the basics of postures and breathing techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Vinyasa Yoga and Ashtanga Yoga can also be great for beginners, but it is important to find a class with a teacher who can guide you through the more complex movements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bikram Yoga and Kundalini Yoga may be more intense and specialized, so it is best to gain some experience in other types of yoga before attempting these practices.  
[USER] The user is seeking tips for finding a good yoga class or teacher.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for finding a good yoga class or teacher include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Research: Look for studios or teachers in your area and read reviews to find out what other students think.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Attend a few classes: Check out a few different classes to find one that suits your needs and preferences.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Ask questions: Don't be afraid to ask the teacher about their experience and training.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Assess the atmosphere: Check out the studio's atmosphere and assess whether it makes you feel comfortable and relaxed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Consider your goals: Consider your goals for practicing yoga, and make sure the class or teacher aligns with those goals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Take advantage of introductory specials: Many studios offer discounted or free introductory classes, so take advantage of them to try out different classes
